findings: Non-blocking: aria-expanded is not updated on mobile (≤768px) because the trigger handler returns early to let main.js own the .active toggle; stays 'false' even when open. Consistent with the language switcher, which exposes no aria-expanded at all.
Non-blocking: Space does not open the trigger since it is an <a href="#"> (Enter does). Consistent with the language switcher, which opens on :focus-within rather than key handlers.
